calculations.original_public_message: The net change in unpaid restructuring liabilities during 2006 equals the December 31, 2006 balance minus the December 31, 2005 balance. From the table: balance at Dec 31, 2006 is $134 million, and balance at Dec 31, 2005 is $116 million. Difference = +$18 million.

raw_final.message: Net change during 2006 = Balance at Dec 31, 2006 ($134 million) - Balance at Dec 31, 2005 ($116 million) = $18 million increase.
